headlines.title: Hackers targeted municipal water systems in 7 states this week, FBI says
headlines.description: Cyberattacks targeting municipal water systems have been reported in at least seven states this week, prompting the FBI and the Environmental Protection Agency to warn utilities nationwide that hackers are trying to disrupt critical water infrastructure.

headlines.title: Dozens dead in migrant crisis rush into Spanish enclave
headlines.description: There are new images surfacing of tens of thousands of migrants rushing into Ceuta, a Spanish enclave, sparking reaction around the world. So far, dozens of people have died in the chaos. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez has the latest.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll revive ‘anti-weaponization’ fund if Blanche’s nomination for AG is blocked
headlines.description: Trump threatened to “push hard” to keep a $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” fund active, amid an ongoing feud between two Republican senators and the Trump administration over Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general.

headlines.title: Nicole ‘Snooki’ Polizzi reveals hysterectomy after cervical cancer diagnosis
headlines.description: An emotional Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi announced on Friday that she underwent a hysterectomy operation to treat Stage 1 cervical cancer, months after first disclosing her diagnosis.
